FAQ’S
What exactly is Ashaeiynn and how is it different from other meditation Centre or platforms?

Ashaeiynn is not just a spiritual center—it’s an advanced astral research institute focused exclusively on Third Eye activation, astral sciences, and ancient mystic vidyas . Unlike generic healing platforms, Ashaeiynn works with Guru Tatwa , deep energy mapping, and channelized astral processes under divine guidance.
I’m a beginner. Can I still join the sessions?

Yes, absolutely. Our Deep Astral Screening is designed to understand your current energy level, aura, and astral potential. Based on that, your spiritual path is customized — so whether you’re a beginner or already on the path, your growth is fully supported.
Are all sessions conducted online?

Yes. All sessions at Ashaeiynn are conducted completely online through secured platforms. This allows seekers from all parts of the world to participate while still receiving authentic astral transmissions and powerful energetic experiences from the safety and comfort of their homes.
What is the Third Eye and how will it help me in real life?
The Third Eye (Ajna Chakra) is your spiritual gateway to intuition, higher knowledge, and astral awareness. When activated properly under guidance:
You gain clarity in decision-making
Start sensing energies and intentions
Get solutions for health, financial, and relationship blocks
Connect with your Kuldevta (ancestral deity)
Experience deeper meditation, protection, and insight
Is this safe? Will there be any side effects?

Yes, all processes at Ashaeiynn are conducted under strict guidance of Guru Tattva . Each session is channelized, protected, and personalized according to your energy system. There are no harmful side effects
What happens after I enroll?
After enrollment, you will:
Undergo a Deep Astral Screening
Be assigned a personal mentor
Receive access to Mool Tattva, and all sessions like negativity removal sessions, mega shaktipath, kuldevta session, mantra chanting, etc.
Be guided into your first astral experience within the Ashaeiynn Ambience

Not to worry. Everyone’s journey is unique. Some feel the energy immediately, while others build sensitivity gradually. The Ashaeiynn system is layered —you’ll receive regular guidance, support, and energetic activations. Over time, your inner senses will open naturally.

Yes. Through proper guidance and regular participation, siddhis (spiritual powers) and divine interactions become accessible. Many aspirants experience:
